description: Lepton momentum-scale and resolution calibration on Z->ll (AN-16-442 3.1.4 and 5.3 adapted to UL16 PFNano): event-level MC template fits of the data in the leg-bin-pair categories (user decision 2026-09-24), per-lepton least squares, iterated with the data corrected and the MC smeared per lepton (bilinear interpolation between the bin mean positions) until the residuals vanish; BW (x) DCB + exponential fits for the AN-style validation.

extract.comment: Loose preselection of the compact pair ntuple, looser than every tight selection the calibration may use: the analysis trigger OR of the skim configuration, raw mass window, both legs FSR-subtracted isolation and SIP

selection.comment: Control-pair legs: the AN tight lepton with the stage-2 floors.  Muon id an_tight: PF muon and (global, or tracker with a matched station); electron id: mvaFall17V2noIso WP90 until the stage-4b choice; isolation = the FSR-subtracted relative isolation (AN).  Thresholds apply to the transformed (data corrected, MC smeared) pT

bins.comment: Lower pT edges; the terminal pT bin and the terminal eta bin are unbounded, internal boundaries half-open [low, high).  Electrons are binned in abs(eta_SC).  Bin index k = ipt * n_eta + ieta.  The lowest bins are split at 10 and 15 GeV (the pT range of the H->4l Z2 leptons).

histogram.comment: Per-category mass histograms at 0.05 GeV for both roles; the template fit rebins the data to fit_bin_width, the validation fits to 0.25 or 1 GeV

template_fit.comment: Event-level templates: every selected MC pair of a category is moved to k m (1 + sqrt(delta^2 + D) eps) with its frozen pair deviate eps (stream 3) and spread by a Gaussian kernel of fixed relative width kernel_rel_sigma (the likelihood is smooth; the smoothing does not vary with D); the data are smeared once by the common known relative delta (frozen pair deviates, stream 2), so the residual extra pair variance D can be negative down to -delta^2.  Reported E = D + kernel_rel_sigma^2.  Free normalization, Barlow-Beeston-lite MC statistical uncertainty per likelihood group (consecutive fit bins merged until the MC template at the starting values holds min_group_mc_entries effective entries).  Window [mode - below, mode + above] from the smeared data mode, clipped to window_clip inside the DY generator cut and the extraction window.

validation_fit.comment: AN-style BW (x) DCB + exponential validation fits (functions and limits after efficiency_tnp_an): window seeded from the data mode, the MC of a category fitted in the window of its data, own numerical convolution (no FFTW plugin in the lxplus ROOT)
